newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin said to order Kremlin's foreign cars sold.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin said to order Kremlin's foreign cars sold.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has ordered officials to start auctioning off the Kremlin's foreign cars, a spokesman for First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov was quoted as saying on Wednesday.

Nemtsov, governor of the Nizhny Novgorod car-making region until joining the cabinet last month, has pushed the federal administration to buy Russian cars instead of foreign makes and to sell off the hundreds of foreign cars already in service.

Itar-Tass and Interfax news agencies said Yeltsin gave Nemtsov the go-ahead for the auctions at a meeting on Wednesday. Nemtsov, who could not be reached for comment, has said the move would save money and create jobs.

But Kremlin officials have put up resistance, saying Russian cars cost more to maintain. The administration signed several contracts for thousands of imported cars last month and a senior official said on Monday it had no intention of cancelling them.
The presidential press service said it had no information on whether Yeltsin had ordered the auctions or not.
